build_both_encoder_ranker: build a BothEncoderRankerAgent that combines a biencoder and crossencoder for two-stage ranking
run_train_step: run a training step on a batch through both the biencoder and crossencoder
run_eval_step: run an evaluation step that filters candidates through biencoder then crossencoder
save_both_encoder_model: save both the biencoder and crossencoder model files to disk
load_both_encoder_model: load both the biencoder and crossencoder model files from disk
